content: लाक्षा [लक्ष्यतेऽनया लक्ष् अच् पृषो˚ वृद्धिः] .²1 A kind of red dye, lac; (largely used by women in ancient times as an article of decoration, especially for the soles of the feet and lips; <ab>cf.</ab> अलक्त; it is said to be obtained from the cochineal insect and from the resin of a particular tree); निष्ठपूतश्चरणोपभोगसुलभो लाक्षारसः केनचित् (तरुणा) <ls>Ś. 4. 5</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 14</ls>; लाक्षागृहानलविषान्नसभाप्रवेशैः <ls>Ve. 1. 8</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 23</ls>. .²2 The insect which produces the red dye.
